needs_human.note: addons/intelligence/app/file_find.py:60-65 `_overlap` scans from min(limit, len(text), len(chunk)) down to _OVERLAP_MIN and returns the first suffix-prefix match. That is the longest match, which is what I12 literally defines, and the limit is the extractor's replay size. In strictly periodic text a match longer than the true replay can therefore drop occurrences. That is inherent to the longest-match definition and the spec records periodic text as a known limit. Whether this counts as a violation of I12's 'no occurrence is dropped' is for the human to decide.
